name: Premier Electric Inc.
old_description: Premier Electric Inc. has always operated under strong values aimed at exceeding client needs. Our communication channels are always open—our relationship with our clients begins on the first day of contact, and only ends once they’re fully satisfied with our work.
about:
Premier Electric Inc. is based in Sheridan, Wyoming, and has served Sheridan and Johnson counties since 2006. The company operates as a full-service electrical contractor and solar installer, though its ownership structure and founders are not publicly disclosed.

The firm provides a range of electrical services including residential, commercial, and industrial installations, repairs, and maintenance. It also designs and installs solar power systems for homes, businesses, and ranches, and fits automatic standby generators for backup power. Additional work covers farm and ranch wiring, kitchen and bath remodels, and new-construction electrical for houses and commercial buildings. No facility size, headcount, or volume metrics are published.

Customers span residential homeowners, commercial property owners, industrial facilities, and agricultural operations such as farms and ranches. Concrete project examples cited by the company include wiring for new homes and commercial buildings, farm and ranch electrical systems, kitchen and bathroom remodels, and solar installations on residential, commercial, and ranch properties.

Premier Electric emphasizes open communication from the first contact through project completion, a commitment to quality craftsmanship and a strong work ethic, punctual service, and personalized options tailored to different budgets. The company states that its client relationships begin on day one and continue until the customer is fully satisfied.
